## What the user decided

Records accept, reject, or a different code against suggestions the current user was shown. It writes nothing to Xero.

An accepted decision stamps a cryptographic hash of the exact line and coding tuple. After the accepted row is persisted, this workflow stores a same-session, five-minute exact confirmation proposal bound to the review run, capture tenant and organisation, and sorted suggestion/hash pairs.

The model cannot call the Xero writer. Only the deterministic confirmation workflow can consume that proposal once and dispatch the internal worker.
